name: user_attempts_invalid_option_then_corrects
goal: User enters an invalid option, then selects the correct employment letter option.
constraints: Employee details must be present. User first enters invalid input, then valid.

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and options.
Bot re-prompts or ignores invalid input, still shows options.
Bot proceeds to trigger mail workflow silently.

phases.description: Bot triggers mail and confirms success.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the exact confirmation message for employment letter request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
